text_block_list.text:
Голд Шип's quest to discover Eden, the

Umamusume utopia described in the
Book of
Secrets, has brought her to an
unknown land.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But unfortunately, she doesn't know how
to get
back home. That's bad news for
both of us, since
she brought me along
against my will.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The prospect of staying here forever is
not
exactly exciting. Is this how Gold
Ship's brilliant
racing career begins?
text_block_list.name: Монолог
